prompts.ready: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent character expression sprite strip for ChickPence web dashboard. Reference image 1 is the supplied mature golden chicken: preserve its recognizable round golden body, red three-lobed comb, cream belly, orange beak, rosy cheeks and friendly cartoony storybook character. Produce ONE coherent character sheet with EXACTLY three equal-width columns in ONE horizontal row, transparent background, no panels, no labels, no words. Each cell contains the same complete mature chicken at exactly the same scale, center and baseline, with generous transparent space between characters. LEFT: happy open smiling beak, friendly raised wing wave. MIDDLE: sad worried eyebrows and downturned beak, wings lowered. RIGHT: tired sleepy half-closed eyes, drooping wings, small yawn, friendly exhausted expression. Cohesive soft hand-painted CARTOON illustration, simplified feather texture, warm golden yellow and cream, no photorealism, no props, no background shadows, no cropping. Character must stay completely inside its own equal third. All backgrounds genuinely transparent. Wide horizontal 3:1 strip.
prompts.growing: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent expression sprite strip for a web app. Reference image is the supplied pale yellow growing pullet. Create ONE coherent horizontal three-column sprite sheet, three equal width cells, no dividers or labels, genuinely transparent background. Same complete cute pullet at identical size and center in each cell. Preserve small red comb and wattles, cream-yellow fluffy pear body, orange beak, rosy cheeks, round dark eyes and storybook CARTOON style, simplified soft painted feathers, no realism. LEFT cell happy smiling beak with raised waving wing; MIDDLE cell sad worried brows and downturned beak, wings lowered; RIGHT cell tired sleepy half-closed eyes, drooping wings and little yawn. No props or text, no backgrounds, no cast shadow. No parts may overlap another cell. Ample transparent margins. Wide horizontal 3:1 strip.
prompts.chick: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent baby chick expression sprite strip for ChickPence. Reference is the user's egg-hat baby chick. Produce ONE coherent character expression sheet with three EQUAL WIDTH columns in one horizontal row, transparent background with alpha, NO panels, words or labels. Same complete round fluffy pale yellow baby chick with a small cracked cream eggshell cap, no comb, tiny orange beak, rosy cheeks, dark round eyes in all three cells. Identical scale and centered alignment, generous margins. LEFT happy open smile and raised waving wing. MIDDLE sad worried eyebrows and downturned beak with lowered wings. RIGHT tired sleepy half-closed eyes, little yawn and drooping wings. Cohesive cartoony soft storybook painted style consistent with reference, simplified feathers, NOT realistic. No ground shadows or background. Each figure fully contained in its own third. Wide horizontal 3:1 strip.
prompts.feather: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent icon for ChickCount AI floating assistant. Edit target: reference image supplied by user. Extract and refine the SINGLE ivory feather, preserving its diagonal upward-right angle, warm cocoa outline, cream/gold highlights and delicate central shaft. Make its finish match a soft cartoony storybook poultry mascot rather than a realistic feather, clean at small size. Remove the beige square, white margins, all cast shadows and everything except the feather. Center it on a genuinely transparent canvas, tight generous padding 8%, no text, no panel, no new symbols.
prompts.login-wallpaper: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-width background texture for ChickPence login page. Use supplied reference image ONLY for background style: pale buttery cream vertical watercolor stripes with thin muted warm peach lines on ivory paper, gently irregular brush edges. Generate ONLY the quiet repeating-looking wallpaper itself, edge-to-edge, no card, no mascot, no letters, no text, no UI, no watermark, no social media logos, no horizontal yellow band. Warm soft hand-painted cartoony storybook feel. Broad mostly ivory gaps for readability. Flat evenly lit seamless-looking wallpaper, delicate watercolor paper texture, landscape 3:2.
